ModMetaData.name: NoMoreDevMode / Earned Resurrection
ModMetaData.author: kergunes
ModMetaData.description: Resurrection should be earned. An established colonist's death can lead to three dangerous expeditions to enemy outposts and a final recovery mission for exactly one vanilla resurrector mech serum. One opportunity per year, one active chain. Requires Core and Harmony. No DLC required. V0.1: human gameplay verification pending.
